files.Title: Bodu.Globalization.Calendar.Algorithms.IDateRecurrenceStrategy
files.Summary: Calculates every occurrence of a recurring notable-date pattern that falls within a bounded date range, such as every second Tuesday or the last Friday of every month.

files.Title: Bodu.Globalization.Calendar.Algorithms.MonthlyDayRecurrenceStrategy

files.Title: Bodu.Globalization.Calendar.Algorithms.MonthlyWeekdayRecurrenceStrategy
files.Summary: Generates an ordinal weekday every fixed number of months, such as the first Monday of every month or the last Friday of every third month.

files.Title: Bodu.Globalization.Calendar.Algorithms.NthWeekdayFromRuleStrategy

files.Title: Bodu.Globalization.Calendar.Algorithms.WeeklyRecurrenceStrategy

files.Summary: Identifies the base period at which a repeats, corresponding to the RFC 5545 FREQ rule part.

files.Title: Bodu.Globalization.Recurrence.RecurrenceRule
files.Summary: Represents an immutable RFC 5545 recurrence rule (RRULE): a base refined by an interval, an optional bound ( or ), and the BY rule parts, from which the set of recurring instants relative to a start date is derived.

files.Title: Bodu.Globalization.Recurrence.RecurrenceRuleBuilder
files.Summary: Builds a fluently, as an alternative to parsing its textual form.

files.Title: Bodu.Globalization.Recurrence.RecurrenceSet
files.Summary: Represents a composed set of recurring instants: one or more streams anchored at a common start, merged with explicit recurrence dates (RDATE) and with exception dates (EXDATE) removed.

files.Title: Bodu.Globalization.Recurrence.WeekDayNum
files.Summary: Represents a single entry in an RFC 5545 BYDAY rule part: a day of the week with an optional ordinal that selects a specific occurrence of that weekday within the frequency period.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffBlankRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded BLANK record: a formatted cell carrying no value.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffBofRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded BOF record: the version marker, the kind of substream being opened, and the build information of the application that wrote it.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffBoolErrRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded BOOLERR record: a cell holding either a boolean or an error code.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffBoundSheetRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded BOUNDSHEET record: one entry of the sheet directory in the workbook globals, giving a sheet's name, visibility, kind, and the absolute stream offset of its substream.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffCachedResultKind
files.Summary: Identifies the kind of cached result a FORMULA record carries in its eight-byte result field.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffCodePageRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded CODEPAGE record: the code page byte strings in the stream are encoded in.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffDateModeRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded DATEMODE record: whether serial dates in the workbook count from 1 January 1904 rather than from the 1900 date system.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffDimensionsRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded DIMENSIONS record: the used row and column extent of a sheet.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffEncryptionType
files.Summary: Identifies the protection scheme a FILEPASS record declares.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffFilePassRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded FILEPASS record: the protection scheme applied to the records that follow it. The codec reports the scheme and the XOR parameters; it does not decrypt.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffFontRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded FONT record: size, style attributes, color, character set, and face name. The name is an 8-bit-length string in both versions — a Unicode string in BIFF8, a code-page byte string in BIFF5.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffFormatException
files.Summary: The exception thrown when BIFF data is structurally invalid: a record header is truncated, a declared payload runs past the available data, or a known record's payload does not match its documented layout.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffFormatRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded FORMAT record: a number-format index and its format code. The code is a 16-bit-length Unicode string in BIFF8 and an 8-bit-length code-page byte string in BIFF5.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffFormulaRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded FORMULA record: the cell's position and format, the cached result of its last calculation, its option flags, and the parsed-expression tokens, which the codec exposes as raw bytes.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffLabelRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded LABEL record: a cell holding an inline text value. The text is a 16-bit-length Unicode string in BIFF8 and a 16-bit-length code-page byte string in BIFF5.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffLabelSstRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded LABELSST record: a cell whose text is an entry of the shared string table (BIFF8).

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffLimits
files.Summary: Defines the structural limits of the BIFF record format.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffLimits.UnicodeCodePage
files.Summary: The code page value a BIFF8 CODEPAGE record carries to declare UTF-16LE text.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffLimits.AbsoluteMaxPayloadLength
files.Summary: The largest payload the 16-bit length field can express, in bytes. A reader tolerates declared lengths up to this value; a writer enforces the per-version maximum.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffLimits.Biff8MaxPayloadLength
files.Summary: The largest payload a BIFF8 record may declare, in bytes.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffLimits.RecordHeaderSize
files.Summary: The size, in bytes, of a record header: a 16-bit identifier followed by a 16-bit payload length.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffLimits.DefaultCodePage
files.Summary: The default code page assumed for byte strings when no CODEPAGE record has been read (Windows-1252).

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffLimits.Biff5MaxPayloadLength
files.Summary: The largest payload a BIFF5 record may declare, in bytes.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffMulBlankRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded MULBLANK record: a run of adjacent blank (formatted, valueless) cells in one row, exposed by index without materializing an array.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffMulRkRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded MULRK record: a run of adjacent RK-encoded number cells in one row, exposed by index without materializing an array.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffNumberRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded NUMBER record: a cell holding an IEEE 754 double-precision value.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffRStringRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded RSTRING record: a BIFF5 rich-text label cell — a 16-bit-length code-page byte string followed by a run table of two-byte entries (character index, font index).

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffReader
files.Summary: Provides a forward-only, allocation-free reader over a BIFF5 or BIFF8 record stream. The reader is a ref struct over the supplied bytes: each call to advances to the next physical record and exposes its identifier, length, and payload slice, and typed accessors decode the records the codec names.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffReaderOptions
files.Summary: Defines the customizations a is created with.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffReaderState
files.Summary: Carries the state a needs to continue a stream across buffers: the established BIFF version and the active code page.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffRecordHeader
files.Summary: Represents the four-byte header that precedes every BIFF record: a 16-bit little-endian record identifier followed by the 16-bit little-endian length of the payload that follows.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffRecordType
files.Summary: Identifies the BIFF record types the codec names. Values are the 16-bit record identifiers defined by the Excel binary file format and are shared by BIFF5 and BIFF8 except where a member's documentation says otherwise.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffRk
files.Summary: Encodes and decodes the RK number representation: a 32-bit value whose two low bits select between a signed 30-bit integer and the high 30 bits of an IEEE 754 double, optionally divided by 100.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffRkCell
files.Summary: Represents one cell of a MULRK run: its extended-format index and RK-encoded value.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffRkRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded RK record: a cell holding a number in the compact RK encoding.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffRowRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded ROW record: a row's used column extent, height, option flags, and default format.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffSheetState
files.Summary: Identifies the visibility a BOUNDSHEET record declares for its sheet.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffSheetType
files.Summary: Identifies the kind of sheet a BOUNDSHEET record describes.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffSstHeader
files.Summary: Represents the counts at the head of an SST record: the total number of string references in the workbook and the number of unique strings the table holds.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffSstReader
files.Summary: Reads the strings of a BIFF8 shared string table (SST) one at a time, pulling the CONTINUE records that carry the table's overflow from the parent as they are needed.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffString
files.Summary: Provides a span-backed view over a text value embedded in a BIFF record — a BIFF8 Unicode string (16-bit or compressed 8-bit characters with option flags, rich-text runs, and extended data) or a BIFF5 code-page byte string — without materializing a until the caller asks for one.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffStringRecord
files.Summary: Represents a decoded STRING record: the cached text result of the FORMULA record that precedes it. The text is a 16-bit-length Unicode string in BIFF8 and a 16-bit-length code-page byte string in BIFF5.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffSubstreamType
files.Summary: Identifies the kind of substream a beginning-of-file record opens.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffUnsupportedVersionException
files.Summary: The exception thrown when a stream is well-formed BIFF but encoded in a version the codec does not process: a BIFF2, BIFF3, or BIFF4 beginning-of-file record, or a BOF whose version field is neither BIFF5 nor BIFF8.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffVersion
files.Summary: Identifies the version of the Binary Interchange File Format (BIFF) a record stream is encoded in.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffWriter
files.Summary: Provides a forward-only writer that emits BIFF5 or BIFF8 records to an . Raw records are written from an identifier and payload; the records the codec names are written from typed values in the layout the selected version requires.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffWriterOptions
files.Summary: Defines the customizations a is created with.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Biff.BiffXfRecord
files.Summary: Represents the leading fields of a decoded XF (extended format) record: the font and number-format indices and the protection and style flags. Alignment, border, and fill fields that follow are not interpreted.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.Builders.CompoundBuildOptions
files.Summary: Specifies options that control how a tree serializes a compound file.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.Builders.CompoundEntryBuilder
files.Summary: Represents a node in a mutable compound-file object model — either a storage (a named container) or a stream (a named byte payload).

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.Builders.CompoundStorageBuilder
files.Summary: Represents a storage entry in a mutable compound-file object model — a named container of child storages and streams.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.Builders.CompoundStorageBuilderOptions
files.Summary: Specifies options that control the behavior of the mutable compound-file object model.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.Builders.CompoundStreamBuilder
files.Summary: Represents a stream entry in a mutable compound-file object model — a named, file-like node carrying an opaque byte payload.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.CompoundEntryColor
files.Summary: Identifies the red-black tree node color recorded for a directory entry.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.CompoundEntryInfo
files.Summary: Provides an immutable snapshot of the metadata recorded for a single compound-file directory entry — a storage, a stream, or the root storage.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.CompoundEntryType
files.Summary: Identifies the kind of object an entry describes within a compound file's directory.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.CompoundFile
files.Summary: Represents an OLE2 / Compound File Binary (CFB) container opened over a path or stream, exposing its storage hierarchy, the metadata of every entry, and the byte payload of each named stream for reading or editing.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.CompoundFileError
files.Summary: Categorizes the structural failure that caused a .

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.CompoundFileException
files.Summary: The base class for exceptions raised by the compound-file reader, writer, and object model.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.CompoundFileFormatException
files.Summary: The exception thrown when a stream cannot be interpreted as a well-formed OLE2 / Compound File Binary container.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.CompoundFileOptions
files.Summary: Specifies options that control how a is opened for reading.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.CompoundFileSerializationException
files.Summary: The exception thrown when a compound file cannot be authored or serialized — for example, when a storage contains a duplicate or invalid child name, the directory nesting is too deep, or a value cannot be represented in the container.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.CompoundFileVersion
files.Summary: Specifies the compound-file format version, which determines the sector size used when writing.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.CompoundReadStrategy
files.Summary: Specifies how the compound-file reader sources the bytes of an opened container.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.CompoundStorage
files.Summary: Represents a storage within a compound file — a named container of child storages and streams — and provides navigation over its immediate children.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.CompoundStream
files.Summary: Provides seekable access to the bytes of a single stream within a compound file.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.CompoundStreamNotFoundException
files.Summary: The exception thrown when a named stream is requested from a compound file but no matching directory entry exists.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.CompoundValidationLevel
files.Summary: Specifies how strictly the compound-file reader validates a container's structure.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.PropertySets.DocumentSummaryInformation
files.Summary: Provides a strongly-typed view over the document-summary-information property set (\x05DocumentSummaryInformation) of a compound file, including any user-defined custom properties.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.PropertySets.DocumentSummaryInformation.StreamName
files.Summary: The directory name of the document-summary-information stream, including its leading control prefix.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.PropertySets.DocumentSummaryInformationBuilder
files.Summary: Authors a document-summary-information property set, producing an that can be embedded as the \x05DocumentSummaryInformation stream of a compound file, including an optional user-defined section of custom named properties.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.PropertySets.OlePropertySection
files.Summary: Represents a single section of an OLE property set — a format-identified group of properties keyed by property identifier (PID).

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.PropertySets.OlePropertySet
files.Summary: Represents a parsed OLE property set — the managed counterpart of the COM IPropertyStorage interface — exposing its sections and the typed values they contain.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.PropertySets.OlePropertyType
files.Summary: Identifies the scalar value type carried by an , corresponding to the COM VARENUM (VT_*) constants used in OLE property sets.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.PropertySets.OlePropertyValue
files.Summary: Represents a single typed value read from an OLE property set, the managed counterpart of a COM PROPVARIANT.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.PropertySets.SummaryInformation
files.Summary: Provides a strongly-typed view over the standard summary-information property set (\x05SummaryInformation) of a compound file.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.PropertySets.SummaryInformation.StreamName
files.Summary: The directory name of the summary-information stream, including its control prefix.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Compound.PropertySets.SummaryInformationBuilder
files.Summary: Authors a standard summary-information property set, producing an that can be embedded as the \x05SummaryInformation stream of a compound file.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.ApHash
files.Summary: Computes a 32-bit non-cryptographic hash using Arash Partow's APHash algorithm, which alternates XOR mixing patterns based on input byte-index parity. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.BKDR.DefaultSeed
files.Summary: Represents the default seed value used by the hash algorithm.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.BKDR
files.Summary: Computes a 32-bit non-cryptographic hash using the BKDR polynomial rolling algorithm from Kernighan and Ritchie's "The C Programming Language". This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.Bernstein
files.Summary: Computes a 32-bit non-cryptographic hash using Daniel J. Bernstein's djb2 algorithm, optionally using the XOR-modified variant. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.Bernstein.DefaultInitialValue
files.Summary: The default initial value used to seed the hash algorithm.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.BlockNonCryptographicHashAlgorithm
files.Summary: Base class for non-cryptographic hash algorithms whose internal state advances one fixed-size block at a time — handles residual buffering, block alignment, total-length tracking, snapshot-based GetCurrentHash, and optional final-block padding so that derived implementations only need to express the per-block compression step.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.BlockNonCryptographicHashAlgorithm.BlockSizeBytes
files.Summary: The fixed size, in bytes, of each block processed by the algorithm.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.AbaRoutingNumber
files.Summary: Computes the check digit of a 9-digit American Bankers Association (ABA) routing transit number using the weighted modulus-10 scheme specified by the US Federal Reserve. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.AbaRoutingNumber.SequenceLength
files.Summary: The required full-sequence length of 9 decimal digits.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.AbaRoutingNumber.BodyLength
files.Summary: The required body length of 8 decimal digits.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.AlphanumericCheckDigitAlgorithm
files.Summary: Represents the abstract base class from which single-character check-digit algorithms that operate on a wider input alphabet, or whose check character may be the sentinel 'X', derive.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.CheckDigitAlgorithm
files.Summary: Represents the abstract base class from which all decimal check-digit algorithms in this library derive.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.CheckDigitInputAlphabet
files.Summary: Identifies the alphabet from which a check-digit or check-character algorithm accepts its body input.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.CheckDigitOutputAlphabet
files.Summary: Identifies the alphabet from which a single-character check-digit algorithm may emit its check character.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.CheckValueAlgorithm
files.Summary: Represents the common root of the check-digit algorithm family, unifying the streaming surface shared by (decimal bodies, single check digit), (alphanumeric bodies, single check character), and (multi-character check codes).

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Code39Mod43
files.Summary: Computes the check character of a Code 39 (also known as Code 3 of 9) symbol string using the modulo 43 scheme. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Crockford32
files.Summary: Computes the check symbol of a Crockford Base32 encoded value using the modulo 37 scheme defined by Douglas Crockford. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Cusip
files.Summary: Computes the check digit of a 9-character Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (CUSIP) identifier using the Luhn-style weighted modulus-10 scheme specified by the American Bankers Association. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Cusip.SequenceLength
files.Summary: The required full-sequence length of 9 characters.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Cusip.BodyLength
files.Summary: The required body length of 8 characters.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Damm
files.Summary: Computes the check digit of a decimal string using the Damm algorithm. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Ean13
files.Summary: Computes the check digit of a 13-digit European Article Number / Global Trade Item Number-13 barcode using the EAN-13 weighted modulus-10 algorithm. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Ean13.BodyLength
files.Summary: The required body length of 12 decimal digits.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Ean13.SequenceLength
files.Summary: The required full-sequence length of 13 decimal digits.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Ean8
files.Summary: Computes the check digit of an 8-digit European Article Number / Global Trade Item Number-8 barcode using the EAN-8 weighted modulus-10 algorithm. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Ean8.SequenceLength
files.Summary: The required full-sequence length of 8 decimal digits.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Ean8.BodyLength
files.Summary: The required body length of 7 decimal digits.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Gtin14
files.Summary: Computes the check digit of a 14-digit Global Trade Item Number (GTIN-14) barcode using the GTIN-14 weighted modulus-10 algorithm. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Gtin14.SequenceLength
files.Summary: The required full-sequence length of 14 decimal digits.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Gtin14.BodyLength
files.Summary: The required body length of 13 decimal digits.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Gumm
files.Summary: Computes the check digit of a decimal string using the Gumm algorithm. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Iban
files.Summary: Computes the two-digit check sequence of an International Bank Account Number (IBAN) using the ISO 13616 algorithm atop ISO 7064 MOD 97-10. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Iban.CountryCodeLength
files.Summary: The length of the country-code prefix (2 letters).

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Iban.CheckDigits
files.Summary: The fixed check-code length of 2 decimal digits.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Isbn10
files.Summary: Computes the check character of a 10-character International Standard Book Number using the ISBN-10 weighted modulus-11 algorithm. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Isbn10.BodyLength
files.Summary: The required body length of 9 decimal digits.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Isbn10.SequenceLength
files.Summary: The required full-sequence length of 10 characters.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Isbn13
files.Summary: Computes the check digit of a 13-digit International Standard Book Number using the ISBN-13 weighted modulus-10 algorithm. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Isin
files.Summary: Computes the check digit of a 12-character International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) using the Luhn-based scheme defined by ISO 6166. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Isin.BodyLength
files.Summary: The required body length of 11 characters.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Isin.SequenceLength
files.Summary: The required full-sequence length of 12 characters.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Iso7064Mod11_2
files.Summary: Computes the single-character check of a decimal string using the ISO 7064 MOD 11-2 pure algorithm. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Iso7064Mod97_10
files.Summary: Computes the 2-character check code of an alphanumeric string using the ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 pure algorithm. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Iso7064Mod97_10.CheckDigits
files.Summary: The fixed check-code length of 2 decimal digits.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Lei.BodyLength
files.Summary: The required body length of 18 characters.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Lei
files.Summary: Computes the two-digit check sequence of a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) as specified by ISO 17442. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Lei.SequenceLength
files.Summary: The required full-sequence length of 20 characters.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Lei.CheckDigits
files.Summary: The fixed check-code length of 2 decimal digits.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Luhn
files.Summary: Computes the check digit of a decimal string using the Luhn (mod 10) algorithm. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.MultiCharCheckDigitAlgorithm
files.Summary: Represents the abstract base class from which check-digit algorithms that emit a fixed-length multi-character check code — most notably ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 and its derivatives (IBAN, LEI) — derive.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Sedol
files.Summary: Computes the check digit of a 7-character Stock Exchange Daily Official List (SEDOL) identifier using the weighted modulus-10 scheme defined by the London Stock Exchange. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Sedol.SequenceLength
files.Summary: The required full-sequence length of 7 characters.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Sedol.BodyLength
files.Summary: The required body length of 6 characters.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.UpcA
files.Summary: Computes the check digit of a 12-digit Universal Product Code (UPC-A) barcode using the UPC-A weighted modulus-10 algorithm. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.UpcA.SequenceLength
files.Summary: The required full-sequence length of 12 decimal digits.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.UpcA.BodyLength
files.Summary: The required body length of 11 decimal digits.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.CheckDigits.Verhoeff
files.Summary: Computes the check digit of a decimal string using the Verhoeff algorithm. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.Checksums.Adler<T>
files.Summary: Provides a generic base class for Adler-style checksum algorithms parameterized by the accumulator type.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.Checksums.Adler<T>.partB
files.Summary: The B accumulator, which holds the running sum of across all processed bytes.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.Checksums.Adler<T>.partA
files.Summary: The A accumulator, initialized to one and updated with each input byte.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.Checksums.Adler32
files.Summary: Computes the zlib-compatible Adler-32 checksum of the input data using the standard modulus 65521. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.Checksums.Adler32Base
files.Summary: Provides a reusable base class for Adler-32 style checksum algorithms using accumulators.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.Checksums.Adler32C
files.Summary: Computes a 32-bit Adler-style checksum using the power-of-two modulus 65536 for SIMD-friendly alignment. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.Checksums.Adler64
files.Summary: Computes a 64-bit Adler-style checksum using the prime modulus 4294967291. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.Checksums.Adler64Base
files.Summary: Provides a reusable base class for Adler-64 style checksum algorithms using accumulators.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.Checksums.Crc
files.Summary: General-purpose CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) engine driven by a parameter set — supports any catalogue width from 1 to 64 bits, snapshot-style intermediate digests, and resumption of a previous digest with additional input.

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.Checksums.CrcLookupTableBuilder
files.Summary: Generates the precomputed lookup tables that drive the byte-at-a-time inner loop of , given the width, polynomial, and input-reflection mode of a .

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.Checksums.CrcLookupTableCache
files.Summary: Thread-safe cache of precomputed CRC lookup tables keyed by width, polynomial, and input reflection — amortizes the per-tuple build cost of across every instance that uses the same .

files.Title: Bodu.IO.Hashing.Checksums.CrcStandard

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Blake2b
files.Summary: AVX-512 vectorised implementation of the BLAKE2b compression function. The 16-element working vector v is laid out as four rows (a, b, c, d), so the four parallel G calls in each column step collapse into a single SIMD G operation. The diagonal step reuses the same kernel by shifting the b, c, d rows by 1/2/3 lanes via VPERMQ, running G, then shifting back — the canonical ChaCha-style vectorisation pattern Blake2 was designed around.

The 16-element working vector v is laid out as four rows (a, b, c, d), so the four parallel G calls in each column step collapse into a single SIMD G operation. The diagonal step reuses the same kernel by shifting the b, c, d rows by 1/2/3 lanes via PSHUFD, running G, then shifting back — the canonical ChaCha-style vectorisation pattern Blake2 was designed around, mirroring the BLAKE2b path with 32-bit lanes in 128-bit registers.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Blake3

The 16-word working state is laid out as four rows (a, b, c, d), so the four parallel G calls in each column step collapse into a single SIMD G operation. The diagonal step reuses the same kernel by shifting the b, c, d rows by 1/2/3 lanes via PSHUFD, running G, then shifting back — the canonical ChaCha-style vectorisation pattern that BLAKE3 inherits from BLAKE2.
