files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Extensions.AeadBlockCipherModeTransformExtensions
files.Summary: Extends with one-shot encrypt/decrypt overloads that handle the associated-data step, size the output buffer correctly, and return the ciphertext + tag (or recovered plaintext) as a single freshly allocated array.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Extensions.AeadTransformExtensions
files.Summary: Provides convenience helpers over that size the output buffer and return a freshly allocated array, for callers who prefer arrays to caller-supplied spans.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Extensions.HashAlgorithmExtensions
files.Summary: Extends with incremental input, async hashing of streams, and constant-time verification against expected digests supplied as bytes, spans, memory, or hex strings.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Extensions.ICryptoTransformExtensions
files.Summary: Extends with one-shot, span/memory-aware, stream-to-stream, and async transform helpers — sized buffers, finalization, and stream pumping rolled into single calls.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Extensions.SymmetricAlgorithmExtensions
files.Summary: Extends with one-shot encrypt/decrypt of buffers, stream-to-stream pipelines, awaitable async variants, and try-pattern transform creation that surfaces validation failures without exceptions.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Extensions.SymmetricAlgorithmExtensions.DefaultBufferSize
files.Summary: The default buffer size, in bytes, used when reading from or writing to streams during encryption and decryption operations.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Extensions.SymmetricStreamAlgorithmExtensions
files.Summary: Extends with one-shot encrypt/decrypt of buffers and stream-to-stream pipelines, mirroring the convenience surface offered for block ciphers.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Extensions.TweakableSymmetricAlgorithmExtensions
files.Summary: Extends with try-pattern transform creation that surfaces invalid key, IV, or tweak material as a false return rather than a thrown .

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.GcmModeTransform
files.Summary: Applies Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) to a 128-bit block cipher, providing single-pass authenticated encryption with associated data (AEAD) per NIST SP 800-38D.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.GcmSivModeTransform
files.Summary: Applies GCM-SIV mode to an underlying , providing nonce-misuse resistant authenticated encryption per RFC 8452.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.HashAlgorithmFactory
files.Summary: Provides static factory helpers for constructing delegate-based implementations of .

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.HashAlgorithmHelper
files.Summary: Provides high-performance utility methods for one-shot hashing using factory-created instances.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.HashValue
files.Summary: Represents the immutable output of a hash operation, with strict hexadecimal parsing, common text formattings, and explicit fixed-time comparison.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Hc128
files.Summary: Provides a managed implementation of the HC-128 stream cipher specified by Hongjun Wu. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Hkdf
files.Summary: Provides the HMAC-based Extract-and-Expand Key Derivation Function (HKDF) defined in RFC 5869, exposing the Extract, Expand, and combined DeriveKey stages over the SHA-1 and SHA-2 family of hash algorithms. This class cannot be instantiated.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Hotp
files.Summary: Provides the HMAC-based One-Time Password (HOTP) algorithm defined in RFC 4226, generating and verifying the counter-based codes used for two-factor authentication. This class cannot be instantiated.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Hpke
files.Summary: Provides the single-shot Hybrid Public Key Encryption (HPKE) operations of RFC 9180 §6, encrypting or decrypting one message to or from a public key in a single call. This class cannot be instantiated.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.HpkeAead
files.Summary: Identifies the Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data (AEAD) function of an HPKE cipher suite, using the algorithm identifiers from the IANA "HPKE AEAD Identifiers" registry defined by RFC 9180 §7.3.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.HpkeKdf
files.Summary: Identifies the Key Derivation Function (KDF) of an HPKE cipher suite, using the algorithm identifiers from the IANA "HPKE KDF Identifiers" registry defined by RFC 9180 §7.2.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.HpkeKem
files.Summary: Identifies the Key Encapsulation Mechanism (KEM) of an HPKE cipher suite, using the algorithm identifiers from the IANA "HPKE KEM Identifiers" registry defined by RFC 9180 §7.1.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.HpkeMode
files.Summary: Identifies the HPKE establishment mode, which controls whether a pre-shared key and/or sender authentication contribute to the key schedule, per RFC 9180 §5.1.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.HpkeReceiver
files.Summary: Represents the recipient side of an HPKE exchange (RFC 9180 §5.2): a session that reconstructs the shared secret from an encapsulated key and then opens any number of sealed messages and exports any number of secrets under that secret. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.HpkeSender
files.Summary: Represents the sender side of an HPKE exchange (RFC 9180 §5.2): a session that encapsulates a shared secret to a recipient once and then seals any number of messages and exports any number of secrets under that secret. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.HpkeSuite
files.Summary: Describes a complete HPKE cipher suite — the combination of a Key Encapsulation Mechanism (KEM), a Key Derivation Function (KDF), and an Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data (AEAD) function — and exposes the derived element lengths defined by RFC 9180. Instances are immutable.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.IAeadBlockCipherModeTransform
files.Summary: Represents an authenticated encryption with associated data (AEAD) block cipher mode transform that encrypts or decrypts data and produces or verifies an integrity tag.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.IAeadTransform
files.Summary: Represents an authenticated encryption with associated data (AEAD) transform — the construction-neutral surface shared by block-cipher AEAD modes () and stream-cipher AEADs ( ). A single call encrypts or decrypts a message together with its associated data; associated data is optional and defaults to empty.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.IBlockCipher
files.Summary: Defines a symmetric block cipher that encrypts and decrypts data one fixed-size block at a time.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.IBlockCipherModeTransform
files.Summary: Defines a stateful block cipher mode transformation that applies a chaining strategy (such as ECB, CBC, CFB, OFB, or CTR) over a block cipher primitive.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.IHashAlgorithmFactory<T>
files.Summary: Defines a factory that produces configured instances of a specific implementation.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.IPaddingStrategy
files.Summary: Defines methods for applying and removing padding to data blocks in block cipher operations.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.IStreamAeadTransform
files.Summary: Represents a stream-cipher authenticated-encryption (AEAD) transform — an backed by a stream cipher and a one-time message-authentication code rather than a block-cipher mode. The extended-nonce Poly1305 AEADs (, , ) implement this surface.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.IStreamCipher
files.Summary: Defines a synchronous, additive stream cipher engine that produces a key- and nonce-dependent keystream in fixed-size blocks.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Iso10126Padding
files.Summary: Implements the ISO 10126 padding scheme, which appends N - 1 cryptographically random bytes followed by a trailing byte holding the padding length N.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Iso7816_4Padding
files.Summary: Implements the ISO/IEC 7816-4 padding scheme (also known as "one-and-zeros" or bit padding). The first pad byte is 0x80 and remaining pad bytes are 0x00.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.KeyedBlockHashAlgorithm
files.Summary: Represents the abstract base class for hash algorithms that require a secret key and process data in fixed-size blocks.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.KeyedBlockHashAlgorithm.KeyValue
files.Summary: Internal storage for the key used by the algorithm. Always assigned via defensive copy and cleared on disposal.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.KeyedBlockHashAlgorithm.KeySizeValue
files.Summary: Holds the required key size, in bits, that the derived algorithm accepts. Supplied via the constructor; aligns with the BCL convention used by . Divide by 8 to obtain the equivalent byte length used when validating .

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.KeyedDeferredFinalBlockHashAlgorithm
files.Summary: Represents the abstract base class for hash algorithms that support an optional secret key and defer compression of the final block until is called, following the BLAKE-family deferred-finalization pattern.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.KeyedDeferredFinalBlockHashAlgorithm.KeyValue
files.Summary: Internal storage for the optional secret key. null when the instance operates in the unkeyed digest profile; otherwise a defensive copy of the caller-supplied key. Always assigned via defensive copy and cleared on disposal.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MLDsa
files.Summary: Provides the family base class for the ML-DSA module-lattice digital signature algorithm standardized by NIST FIPS 204, exposed through the standard framework. Use the sealed , , or parameter sets.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MLDsa.MaxContextSizeInBytes
files.Summary: The maximum length, in bytes, of the signature context string.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MLDsa.PrivateSeedSizeInBytes
files.Summary: The size, in bytes, of the private seed ξ accepted by .

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MLDsa44
files.Summary: Provides the ML-DSA-44 parameter set of NIST FIPS 204 (matrix 4×4, NIST security category 2). This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MLDsa65
files.Summary: Provides the ML-DSA-65 parameter set of NIST FIPS 204 (matrix 6×5, NIST security category 3 — the most widely recommended general-purpose set). This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MLDsa87
files.Summary: Provides the ML-DSA-87 parameter set of NIST FIPS 204 (matrix 8×7, NIST security category 5). This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MLKem
files.Summary: Provides the family base class for the ML-KEM module-lattice key-encapsulation mechanism standardized by NIST FIPS 203, exposed through the standard framework. Use the sealed , , or parameter sets.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MLKem.PrivateSeedSizeInBytes
files.Summary: The size, in bytes, of the private seed d ‖ z accepted by .

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MLKem.SharedSecretSizeInBytes
files.Summary: The size, in bytes, of the shared secret produced by encapsulation and decapsulation.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MLKem1024
files.Summary: Provides the ML-KEM-1024 parameter set of NIST FIPS 203 (module rank 4, NIST security category 5, comparable to AES-256). This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MLKem512
files.Summary: Provides the ML-KEM-512 parameter set of NIST FIPS 203 (module rank 2, NIST security category 1, comparable to AES-128). This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MLKem768
files.Summary: Provides the ML-KEM-768 parameter set of NIST FIPS 203 (module rank 3, NIST security category 3, comparable to AES-192) — the parameter set most widely deployed for TLS hybrid key exchange. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MerkleBlockAccumulator
files.Summary: Accumulates a byte stream into fixed-size Merkle leaves as it is written, so a root can be produced from the same calls that already feed a flat digest — without a second pass over the input.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MerkleBlockComputation
files.Summary: Represents the result of one block-mode Merkle computation: the tree's root, the shape of the input it was taken over, and the ordered leaf hashes an authentication path is built from.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MerkleTree
files.Summary: The block arithmetic every consumer of block mode shares — the number of blocks a byte length divides into, and the offset and length of each one.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MerkleTreeDiagnostics.Node
files.Summary: Represents a single node captured during a Merkle tree computation, recording the child hashes used as input and the hash value produced as output.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.MerkleTreeDiagnostics
files.Summary: Captures the complete node-by-node trace of a Merkle computation, and provides structural inspection and independent hash re-validation.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.NoPadding
files.Summary: Represents a pass-through padding strategy that adds and removes no bytes, requiring the caller to provide data whose length is already a multiple of the cipher block size.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Nonce
files.Summary: Represents a number-used-once supplied to an authenticated-encryption or stream-cipher operation.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.OcbModeTransform
files.Summary: Applies Offset CodeBook mode version 3 (OCB3) to an underlying , providing single-pass authenticated encryption with associated data per RFC 7253.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.OfbModeTransform
files.Summary: Applies the Output Feedback (OFB) mode transformation to an underlying , turning it into a synchronous stream cipher in which encryption and decryption are identical operations.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.OtpHashAlgorithm
files.Summary: Specifies the HMAC hash algorithm used to derive one-time-password codes, as permitted by the HOTP (RFC 4226) and TOTP (RFC 6238) specifications.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.PaddingFactory
files.Summary: Creates instances for the framework values and for the extended values.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.PaddingModeKind
files.Summary: Specifies a padding scheme for block-cipher operations. Mirrors the standard framework values and extends that surface with additional padding schemes that are not part of the framework enum.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs7Padding
files.Summary: Implements the PKCS#7 padding scheme (RFC 5652), which appends N bytes of value N to align the input to the cipher block size.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Poly1305
files.Summary: Computes the message authentication code (MAC) for the input data using the Poly1305 algorithm. This implementation enforces one-time key usage and produces a fixed 16-byte (128-bit) tag from a 256-bit key, as specified in RFC 8439.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Poly1305.KeySize
files.Summary: Length of the Poly1305 key is 256 bits (32 bytes).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Poly1305AeadTransform
files.Summary: Provides the common implementation shared by the extended-nonce Poly1305 AEAD constructions — argument validation, buffer-overlap rules, single-use lifecycle, and secure clearing of retained key material. Derived types supply the keystream engine and, when required, an alternative framing.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Rabbit
files.Summary: Provides a managed implementation of the Rabbit stream cipher specified by RFC 4503. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.RawKeyAsymmetricAlgorithm
files.Summary: Serves as the base class for the library's raw-key asymmetric algorithms (X25519, Ed25519, ML-KEM, ML-DSA), centralizing the shared key-material lifecycle: ownership of the current , zeroizing replacement, dispose-time clearing, and the disposed-state guard.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Salsa20
files.Summary: Provides a managed implementation of the Salsa20 stream cipher specified by Daniel J. Bernstein. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Salt
files.Summary: Represents a salt supplied to a key-derivation or password-hashing operation.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Scrypt
files.Summary: Computes the scrypt sequential memory-hard password-hashing and key-derivation function defined by RFC 7914. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.ScryptParameters
files.Summary: Specifies the cost parameters for a scrypt key-derivation or password-hashing operation, as defined by RFC 7914.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.SecretBytes
files.Summary: Provides a disposable holder for sensitive byte material that pins its buffer and zeroes it on disposal.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Serpent
files.Summary: Serves as the abstract base class for the non-standard wide-block tweakable Serpent variants ( , , and ).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Serpent.KeySizeBytes
files.Summary: The key size in bytes.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Serpent.BlockSizeBytes
files.Summary: The block size in bytes.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Serpent1024
files.Summary: Provides a managed implementation of the non-standard wide-block tweakable Serpent-1024 symmetric block cipher, which operates on 1024-bit (128-byte) blocks using a 1024-bit key and a 128-bit tweak. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Serpent1024Cipher.KeySize
files.Summary: Length of the Serpent-1024 key is 1024 bits (128 bytes).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Serpent1024Cipher
files.Summary: Implements the wide-block tweakable Serpent-1024 block cipher variant, which operates on 1024-bit (128-byte) blocks using a 1024-bit key and a 128-bit tweak. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Serpent128
files.Summary: Provides a managed implementation of the canonical Serpent symmetric block cipher, which operates on 128-bit (16-byte) blocks using a 128, 192, or 256-bit key. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Serpent128Cipher
files.Summary: Implements the canonical Serpent block cipher, which operates on 128-bit (16-byte) blocks using a 128, 192, or 256-bit key.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Serpent256
files.Summary: Provides a managed implementation of the non-standard wide-block tweakable Serpent-256 symmetric block cipher, which operates on 256-bit (32-byte) blocks using a 256-bit key and a 128-bit tweak. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Serpent256Cipher
files.Summary: Implements the wide-block tweakable Serpent-256 block cipher variant, which operates on 256-bit (32-byte) blocks using a 256-bit key and a 128-bit tweak. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Serpent256Cipher.KeySize
files.Summary: Length of the Serpent-256 key is 256 bits (32 bytes).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Serpent512
files.Summary: Provides a managed implementation of the non-standard wide-block tweakable Serpent-512 symmetric block cipher, which operates on 512-bit (64-byte) blocks using a 512-bit key and a 128-bit tweak. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Serpent512Cipher
files.Summary: Implements the wide-block tweakable Serpent-512 block cipher variant, which operates on 512-bit (64-byte) blocks using a 512-bit key and a 128-bit tweak. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Serpent512Cipher.KeySize
files.Summary: Length of the Serpent-512 key is 512 bits (64 bytes).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.SerpentBlockCipher
files.Summary: Serves as the abstract base class for the non-standard wide-block tweakable Serpent engines ( , , ).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.SerpentBlockCipherBase
files.Summary: Serves as the abstract base class for managed Serpent block cipher engines, providing the shared S-boxes, bitsliced linear transform, prekey recurrence, and resource-disposal plumbing used by the standard Serpent-128 variant and the non-standard wide-block tweakable variants (Serpent-256, Serpent-512, Serpent-1024).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Shake
files.Summary: Computes a hash using the SHAKE family of extendable output functions (XOFs) as defined in NIST FIPS 202. Supports security levels of 128 and 256 bits with a configurable output size. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.SignatureFormat
files.Summary: Specifies the wire encoding of a digital-signature value.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.SignatureValue
files.Summary: Represents a digital-signature value together with its wire encoding.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.SipHash.KeySize
files.Summary: Length of the SipHash key is 128 bits (16 bytes).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.SipHash
files.Summary: Base class for the SipHash family of keyed pseudorandom functions, a fast keyed hash designed by Aumasson and Bernstein for short input messages. See the official SipHash specification for details.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.SipHash.MinFinalizationRounds
files.Summary: The minimum number of finalization rounds required by SipHash.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.SipHash.MinCompressionRounds
files.Summary: The minimum number of compression rounds required by SipHash.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.SipHash128
files.Summary: Computes a 128-bit keyed hash using the algorithm by Aumasson and Bernstein. Produces a 16-byte authentication tag from a 128-bit key, offering increased collision resistance over . This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.SipHash64
files.Summary: Computes a 64-bit keyed hash using the algorithm by Aumasson and Bernstein. Produces an 8-byte authentication tag from a 128-bit key and is intended to protect hash tables against collision-based denial-of-service attacks. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.SivModeTransform
files.Summary: Applies Synthetic Initialization Vector (SIV) mode to two underlying instances, providing deterministic authenticated encryption per RFC 5297 (AES-SIV).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Skein
files.Summary: Serves as the abstract base class for managed implementations of the Skein family of cryptographic hash functions, built by Bruce Schneier and co-authors on top of the tweakable block cipher and submitted as a finalist to the NIST SHA-3 competition.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Skein.MaxKeySize
files.Summary: Maximum accepted length for across every Skein variant is 8192 bits (1024 bytes). Keys longer than this bound are rejected to prevent unbounded memory usage; this value is far above any practical MAC key.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Skein1024
files.Summary: Computes a hash using the Skein-1024 variant of the Skein hash function, built on top of the tweakable block cipher. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Skein256
files.Summary: Computes a hash using the Skein-256 variant of the Skein hash function, built on top of the tweakable block cipher. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Skein512
files.Summary: Computes a hash using the Skein-512 variant of the Skein hash function, built on top of the tweakable block cipher. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Skipjack
files.Summary: Provides a managed implementation of the Skipjack symmetric block cipher, exposing the engine through the standard framework. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.SkipjackBlockCipher.KeySize
files.Summary: Length of the Skipjack key is 80 bits (10 bytes).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.SkipjackBlockCipher
files.Summary: Provides a managed implementation of the block cipher engine, operating on 64-bit blocks with an 80-bit key over 32 rounds. Skipjack was designed by the United States National Security Agency (NSA) and declassified in 1998; the key schedule and Rule A / Rule B alternation are binary-compatible with the NSA reference implementation published in FIPS PUB 185 (1994).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Snefru
files.Summary: Base class for the Snefru family of unkeyed hash functions designed by Ralph Merkle, implementing the core compression routine using S-box substitutions and word rotations over 512-bit blocks.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Snefru128
files.Summary: Computes a 128-bit (16-byte) hash using the Snefru hash algorithm by Ralph Merkle. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Snefru256
files.Summary: Computes a 256-bit (32-byte) hash using the Snefru hash algorithm by Ralph Merkle. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.SymmetricStreamAlgorithm
files.Summary: Provides the common base for the library's additive (symmetric, shared-key) stream ciphers, sharing key and nonce storage, validation, generation, transform creation, and disposal.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Threefish
files.Summary: Serves as the abstract base class for managed implementations of the Threefish tweakable symmetric block cipher family (Threefish-256, Threefish-512, and Threefish-1024).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Threefish1024
files.Summary: Provides a managed implementation of the Threefish-1024 tweakable symmetric block cipher, which operates on 1024-bit (128-byte) blocks using a 1024-bit key and a 128-bit tweak. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Threefish1024Cipher
files.Summary: AVX-512 vectorised implementation of . The sixteen 64-bit state words are split across two registers — loVec holds the eight even-position words (x0, x2, x4, x6, x8, x10, x12, x14) and hiVec the eight odd-position words (x1, x3, x5, x7, x9, x11, x13, x15). Each round performs a vector add, a per-lane variable rotate ( VPROLVQ), an XOR, and a pair of single-source VPERMQ shuffles that realign the registers for the next round's MIX pairing.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Threefish1024Cipher.KeySize
files.Summary: Length of the Threefish-1024 key is 1024 bits (128 bytes).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Threefish256
files.Summary: Provides a managed implementation of the Threefish-256 tweakable symmetric block cipher, which operates on 256-bit (32-byte) blocks using a 256-bit key and a 128-bit tweak. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Threefish256Cipher
files.Summary: AVX-512 vectorised implementation of . The four 64-bit state words are split across two registers — lo holds the even-position words (b0, b2) and hi the odd-position words (b1, b3). Each round performs a vector add, a per-lane variable rotate (VPROLVQ ), an XOR, and a single 64-bit lane swap on hi that realigns it for the next round's MIX pairing.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Threefish256Cipher.KeySize
files.Summary: Length of the Threefish-256 key is 256 bits (32 bytes).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Threefish512
files.Summary: Provides a managed implementation of the Threefish-512 tweakable symmetric block cipher, which operates on 512-bit (64-byte) blocks using a 512-bit key and a 128-bit tweak. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Threefish512Cipher
files.Summary: AVX-512 vectorised implementation of . The eight 64-bit state words are split across two registers — lo holds the even-position words (x0, x2, x4, x6) and hi the odd-position words (x1, x3, x5, x7) — and each round applies a vector add, a per-lane variable rotate (VPROLVQ), an XOR, and a pair of lane shuffles that realign the registers for the next round's MIX pairing.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Threefish512Cipher.KeySize
files.Summary: Length of the Threefish-512 key is 512 bits (64 bytes).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.ThreefishBlockCipher
files.Summary: Serves as the abstract base class for managed Threefish block cipher engines, providing shared key and tweak scheduling, resource disposal, and the core MIX/UNMIX primitives used by the Threefish-256, Threefish-512, and Threefish-1024 variants.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Tiger
files.Summary: Computes a hash using the Tiger cryptographic hash algorithm by Ross Anderson and Eli Biham (1996), optimized for 64-bit platforms. Supports output sizes of 128, 160, or 192 bits and both the original and padding variants. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.TigerHashingVariant
files.Summary: Specifies the padding variant used by the hashing algorithm.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Totp
files.Summary: Provides the Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) algorithm defined in RFC 6238, generating and verifying the time-derived codes used for two-factor authentication. This class cannot be instantiated.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.TransformMode
files.Summary: Defines the direction of a cryptographic transformation.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.TweakableSymmetricAlgorithm
files.Summary: Serves as the abstract base class for tweakable symmetric algorithms, which accept an additional tweak value in addition to the key and initialization vector.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.TweakableSymmetricAlgorithm.TweakValue
files.Summary: Stores the current tweak value used by the algorithm.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.TweakableSymmetricAlgorithm.TweakSizeValue
files.Summary: Stores the currently configured tweak size, in bits, for the algorithm instance.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.TweakableSymmetricAlgorithm.LegalTweakSizesValue
files.Summary: Specifies the tweak sizes, in bits, that are supported by the algorithm.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Twofish
files.Summary: Provides a managed implementation of the Twofish symmetric block cipher. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.TwofishBlockCipher
files.Summary: Provides the core Twofish block cipher engine, implementing low-level encryption and decryption of individual 128-bit blocks.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.Whirlpool
files.Summary: Computes a 512-bit cryptographic hash using the Whirlpool algorithm designed by Paulo S. L. M. Barreto and Vincent Rijmen. Supports all three published revisions: Whirlpool-0 (2000), Whirlpool-T (2001) and the final Whirlpool function standardized by ISO/IEC 10118-3 in 2003. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.WhirlpoolVersion
files.Summary: Specifies the published revision of the hash algorithm selected by .

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.X25519
files.Summary: Provides a managed implementation of the X25519 elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman key agreement function defined in RFC 7748, exposed through the standard framework. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.X25519.KeySizeInBytes
files.Summary: The size, in bytes, of an X25519 private key and public key (32 bytes each).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.X25519.SharedSecretSizeInBytes
files.Summary: The size, in bytes, of the shared secret produced by .

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.XChaCha20
files.Summary: Provides a managed implementation of the extended-nonce XChaCha20 stream cipher. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.XChaCha20Poly1305
files.Summary: Provides authenticated encryption with associated data (AEAD) using the extended-nonce XChaCha20-Poly1305 construction. Accepts a 256-bit key and a 192-bit nonce and produces a 128-bit authentication tag. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.XChaCha20Poly1305.KeySize
files.Summary: Length of the XChaCha20-Poly1305 key is 256 bits (32 bytes).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.XChaCha20Poly1305.NonceSize
files.Summary: Length of the XChaCha20-Poly1305 nonce is 192 bits (24 bytes).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.XSalsa20
files.Summary: Provides a managed implementation of the extended-nonce XSalsa20 stream cipher specified by Daniel J. Bernstein. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.XSalsa20Poly1305
files.Summary: Provides authenticated encryption using the XSalsa20-Poly1305 construction of NaCl / libsodium crypto_secretbox, with the Bodu AEAD combined layout ciphertext ‖ tag. Accepts a 256-bit key and a 192-bit nonce and produces a 128-bit authentication tag. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.XSalsa20Poly1305.NonceSize
files.Summary: Length of the XSalsa20-Poly1305 nonce is 192 bits (24 bytes).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.XSalsa20Poly1305.KeySize
files.Summary: Length of the XSalsa20-Poly1305 key is 256 bits (32 bytes).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.XSalsa20Poly1305Aead
files.Summary: Provides authenticated encryption with associated data (AEAD) using the XSalsa20 stream cipher with the RFC 8439 Poly1305 framing. Accepts a 256-bit key and a 192-bit nonce and produces a 128-bit authentication tag. This class cannot be inherited.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.XSalsa20Poly1305Aead.KeySize
files.Summary: Length of the XSalsa20-Poly1305 key is 256 bits (32 bytes).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.XSalsa20Poly1305Aead.NonceSize
files.Summary: Length of the XSalsa20-Poly1305 nonce is 192 bits (24 bytes).

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.XtsModeTransform
files.Summary: Applies XEX-based Tweaked CodeBook mode with ciphertext Stealing (XTS) to an underlying pair of instances, per IEEE Std 1619-2007 / NIST SP 800-38E.

files.Title: Bodu.Security.Cryptography.ZeroPadding
files.Summary: Implements zero-byte padding, appending 0x00 bytes until the input aligns with the cipher block size.

files.Title: Bodu.Sequences.SequenceGenerator
files.Summary: Provides static factory methods that produce lazily evaluated sequences without materializing the underlying collection — both general-purpose shapes (Range, NextWhile, Factory) and a catalogue of well-known mathematical sequences (Fibonacci, Farey, Leibniz, look-and-say, and Thue–Morse).

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.BencodeFormatException
files.Summary: Represents an error that occurs when bencoded data is malformed.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.BencodeSerializationException
files.Summary: The exception thrown when a value cannot be bound to or from a Bencode document during serialization — for example a type mismatch, a missing required member, or a value Bencode cannot represent.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.BencodeSerializer
files.Summary: Provides static methods for serializing values to Bencode (BEP 3) bytes and deserializing Bencode bytes back into values, mapping plain CLR objects to and from the format through configurable converters.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.BencodeSerializerDefaults
files.Summary: Specifies a base set of defaults applied when a instance is created for a particular usage scenario.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.BencodeSerializerOptions
files.Summary: Configures how values are serialized to and deserialized from Bencode: the converters to use, the property naming policy, the default ignore condition, and the maximum nesting depth.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.BencodeSerializerOptions.DefaultMaxDepth
files.Summary: The default maximum nesting depth.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.BencodeTokenType
files.Summary: Identifies the kind of token a is positioned on.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.BencodeValueKind
files.Summary: Identifies the kind of value a Bencode element represents.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Document.BencodeDocument
files.Summary: Provides a read-only, high-performance document object model over Bencode (BEP 3) bytes. The source is parsed once into a flat metadata index and exposed through lightweight struct views; no node tree is materialized.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Document.BencodeDocumentOptions
files.Summary: Defines the customizations applied when parsing a .

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Document.BencodeElement.ArrayEnumerator
files.Summary: Enumerates the elements of an array in order.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Document.BencodeElement.ObjectEnumerator
files.Summary: Enumerates the key/value pairs of an object in stored order.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Document.BencodeElement
files.Summary: Represents a single read-only value within a . The element is a lightweight view — a pair of the owning document and a row index — so copying it is cheap and never materializes a node.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Document.BencodeProperty
files.Summary: Represents a single key/value pair within an object . Instances are produced by .

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Nodes.BencodeArray
files.Summary: Represents a mutable Bencode (BEP 3) list as an ordered, index-addressable collection of child nodes.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Nodes.BencodeNode
files.Summary: Represents a single node in a mutable Bencode (BEP 3) document object model, serving as the base for the three concrete node kinds — , , and .

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Nodes.BencodeNodeOptions
files.Summary: Defines the customizations applied to a mutable Bencode (BEP 3) node tree.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Nodes.BencodeObject
files.Summary: Represents a mutable Bencode (BEP 3) dictionary as a string-keyed collection of child nodes.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Nodes.BencodeValue
files.Summary: Represents a scalar Bencode (BEP 3) value — either an integer or a byte string — within a node tree.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Reader.BencodeReaderOptions
files.Summary: Defines the customizations applied when creating a .

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Reader.Utf8BencodeReader
files.Summary: Provides a high-performance, forward-only, allocation-light reader for Bencode (BEP 3) bytes. The reader is a ref struct, so it lives on the stack and cannot be boxed or captured; pass it by ref to thread it through a converter.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Serialization.BencodeConverter<T>
files.Summary: Converts a value of type T to and from the Bencode reader and writer. This is the base authors derive to customize how a specific type is serialized.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Serialization.BencodeConverter
files.Summary: Serves as the non-generic base for every Bencode converter. The hierarchy is closed to two extension points: , which converts a single type, and , which produces a converter for a family of types.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Serialization.BencodeConverterFactory
files.Summary: Produces a for a family of types that cannot be served by a single — for example every , every enumeration, or every collection.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Serialization.BencodeNumberEnumConverter<TEnum>
files.Summary: Produces a converter that serializes the enumeration TEnum as a Bencode integer carrying its underlying numeric value.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Serialization.BencodeStringEnumConverter<TEnum>
files.Summary: Produces a converter that serializes the enumeration TEnum as a Bencode byte string holding its member name, applying an optional naming policy and honoring on individual members.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Serialization.BencodeStringEnumConverter
files.Summary: Produces a converter that serializes any enumeration as a Bencode byte string holding its member name, applying an optional naming policy and honoring on individual members.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Writer.BencodeWriterOptions
files.Summary: Defines the customizations applied when creating a .

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Bencode.Writer.Utf8BencodeWriter
files.Summary: Provides a forward-only writer that emits canonical Bencode (BEP 3) bytes to an . Because the grammar requires dictionary keys in ascending bytewise order, the writer buffers each dictionary's entries and sorts them when the dictionary is closed; values at the root and inside lists stream directly to the destination.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationDiagnostic
files.Summary: Represents a single diagnostic — informational message, warning, or recoverable error — produced while reading or resolving a configuration document.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationDiagnosticCode
files.Summary: Identifies a specific class of . Codes are stable so that consumers may suppress, filter, or test for particular conditions without inspecting the message text.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationDiagnosticMode
files.Summary: Controls how the reader reacts to recoverable diagnostics — either throwing immediately, gathering them on the resulting document, or silently ignoring them.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationDiagnosticSeverity
files.Summary: Classifies the severity of a emitted while reading or resolving a configuration document.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationDocument
files.Summary: Represents a parsed Bodu Text Configuration document and provides the profile-aware entry points for parsing, loading, and saving such documents. It inherits the read-only INI model from (global section, named sections, lookup) and adds Bodu-specific behaviour — profile presets, inline-comment-mode handling, diagnostic routing, and round-trip support — on top of the shared INI infrastructure.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationExtensions
files.Summary: Extension methods that layer Bodu Text Configuration behaviour (path-aware resolution and dotted-to-colon key mapping) onto the underlying and primitives.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationInlineCommentMode
files.Summary: Controls how the reader treats # or ; characters that appear after a property value.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationKey
files.Summary: Represents a configuration key in both its raw, file-level form and its colon-delimited logical form used by the resolved view and by Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationKeyMapping
files.Summary: Selects how raw configuration keys are mapped to the colon-delimited logical keys used by the resolved view and by Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationKeyOptions
files.Summary: Controls how raw configuration keys are split into segments and mapped to the colon-delimited logical key shape used by the resolved view and the Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration bridge.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationMissingPathRootMode
files.Summary: Selects how reacts when the document was parsed from a string and no was supplied.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationParseException
files.Summary: The exception raised when a configuration document cannot be parsed. Exposes the originating diagnostic ( ) together with any additional diagnostics gathered before the failure.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationParseOptions
files.Summary: Controls how a configuration document is parsed: comment handling, duplicate handling, diagnostic routing, length limits, and the key mapping options.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationParseResult
files.Summary: Carries the outcome of a configuration parse: the populated and any diagnostics collected during the parse.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationPattern
files.Summary: A compiled EditorConfig-style glob pattern that matches forward-slash-delimited paths.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationProfile
files.Summary: Selects one of the predefined behaviour profiles that govern how a configuration document is parsed, resolved, and re-emitted.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationResolveOptions
files.Summary: Controls how a is projected into a for a specific target path.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationResolvedEntry
files.Summary: Carries the origin metadata for a single key/value pair in a — which section "won" for the key, which line of which file supplied the value, and the resolved key path itself.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationSectionHeaderMode
files.Summary: Controls how the reader treats non-whitespace text after the closing ] of a section header.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationSourceLocation
files.Summary: Identifies a specific position in a configuration source document so that diagnostics, exceptions, and model elements can point back to the originating line and column.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationUnsetValueMode
files.Summary: Selects how the resolver treats the literal value unset, which EditorConfig defines as a sentinel that removes the effect of any previously set property for the matching path.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationView
files.Summary: Represents the resolved snapshot of a configuration document for a specific target path: a flattened dictionary of configuration keys to their effective values, computed by layering preamble and matching sections in source order.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.ConfigurationWriteOptions
files.Summary: Controls how a configuration document is emitted by and related methods.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.DuplicateKeyPolicy
files.Summary: Specifies how the configuration parser resolves a key that appears more than once within the same section.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.IniComment
files.Summary: Represents a single comment line preserved as trivia within an .

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.IniDocument
files.Summary: Represents a mutable INI-style document, providing access to the global section and all named sections, together with a mutation surface for authoring documents programmatically.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.IniDocumentBase
files.Summary: Provides the shared, read-oriented model for an INI-style document: a global section plus an ordered set of named sections, with name-based lookup. Serves as the common base for the mutable and for configuration-layer document types that expose only a read surface.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.IniDuplicateSectionBehavior
files.Summary: Defines how the configuration parser resolves a section name that appears more than once in the source.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.IniEntry
files.Summary: Represents a single key/value entry within an . The key and value are immutable data; callers assemble documents programmatically through the owning and may edit comment trivia before writing the document back out.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Configuration.IniSection
files.Summary: Represents a single [section] block in an INI-style configuration document, exposing its ordered entries and providing O(1) key lookup with optional typed value conversion.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.DelimitedDuplicateHeaderBehavior
files.Summary: Specifies how a delimited reader resolves a header row that contains the same column name more than once.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.DelimitedFieldCountBehavior
files.Summary: Specifies how a delimited reader treats a data record whose field count differs from the header's.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.DelimitedFormatException
files.Summary: Represents an error that occurs when delimited (CSV/TSV) data is malformed, such as an unterminated quoted field or a record whose field count violates the configured policy.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.DelimitedMalformedRecordBehavior
files.Summary: Specifies how a delimited reader responds to a record that violates the configured field-count policy.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.DelimitedRecordAttribute
files.Summary: Marks a partial record POCO for compile-time delimited binding: the Bodu.Text.Formats.Generators source generator emits an implementation for the type, exposed through a generated static DelimitedFactory property.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.DelimitedSerializationException
files.Summary: Represents an error that occurs while mapping .NET records to or from delimited text with , such as a non-collection root or a value that cannot be converted to the target column type.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.DelimitedSerializer
files.Summary: Provides methods for serializing collections of .NET records to delimited (RFC 4180 CSV/TSV) text and deserializing delimited text into records, shaped after System.Text.Json's JsonSerializer.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.DelimitedSerializerDefaults
files.Summary: Specifies a set of default settings a can be initialized from.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.DelimitedSerializerOptions
files.Summary: Provides configuration for , controlling column naming, case sensitivity, field inclusion, and the output delimiter, quote, and header behaviour.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.DelimitedTokenType
files.Summary: Enumerates the token kinds a reports as it advances through a delimited (CSV/TSV) document.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.DelimitedValueKind
files.Summary: Enumerates the value kinds a delimited node or element can represent.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.Document.DelimitedDocument
files.Summary: Provides a read-only, forward-parsed view over a delimited (CSV/TSV) document, shaped after System.Text.Json's JsonDocument. The document is an array of records.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.Document.DelimitedElement.ArrayEnumerator
files.Summary: Enumerates the child elements of a array.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.Document.DelimitedElement.ObjectEnumerator
files.Summary: Enumerates the fields of a record object.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.Document.DelimitedElement
files.Summary: Represents a single element — the document array, a record, or a field value — within a , shaped after System.Text.Json's JsonElement.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.Document.DelimitedProperty
files.Summary: Represents a single column-name/value field of a record object.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.IDelimitedRecordFactory<TRecord>
files.Summary: Provides reflection-free conversion between a record type and its delimited field representation, consumed by the factory overloads.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.Nodes.DelimitedArray
files.Summary: Represents an array node in a mutable delimited document tree: the document of records, or a positional (headerless) record of string fields.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.Nodes.DelimitedNode
files.Summary: Represents a node in a mutable delimited (CSV/TSV) document tree. A delimited document is an array of records, so the tree has three concrete shapes: a (the document, or a positional record), a (a header-keyed record), and a string field.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.Nodes.DelimitedObject
files.Summary: Represents a header-keyed record object in a mutable delimited document tree: an insertion-ordered map of column names to field values.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.Nodes.DelimitedValue
files.Summary: Represents a string-valued field in a mutable delimited document tree.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.Reader.DelimitedReaderOptions
files.Summary: Provides configuration for a , controlling the delimiter, quoting, header handling, and the field-count and duplicate-header policies.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.Reader.Utf8DelimitedReader
files.Summary: Provides a high-performance, forward-only reader for delimited (RFC 4180 CSV/TSV) bytes. The reader is a ref struct, so it lives on the stack and cannot be boxed or captured.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.Writer.DelimitedWriterOptions
files.Summary: Provides configuration for a , controlling the delimiter, quote character, and whether a header row is emitted for object records.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Delimited.Writer.Utf8DelimitedWriter
files.Summary: Provides a forward-only writer that emits delimited (RFC 4180 CSV/TSV) text as UTF-8 bytes to an or a . The writer is a ref struct.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.Document.DotEnvDocument
files.Summary: Provides a read-only, forward-parsed view over a DotEnv document, shaped after System.Text.Json's JsonDocument. The document is a flat object of string-valued keys; comment trivia is not retained.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.Document.DotEnvElement.ObjectEnumerator
files.Summary: Enumerates the properties of a object.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.Document.DotEnvElement
files.Summary: Represents a single element — the root object or one of its string values — within a , shaped after System.Text.Json's JsonElement.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.Document.DotEnvProperty
files.Summary: Represents a single name/value property of a object.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.DotEnvFormatException
files.Summary: Represents an error that occurs when DotEnv data is malformed.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.DotEnvSerializationException
files.Summary: Represents an error that occurs while mapping a .NET object to or from DotEnv with , such as an unsupported root type, a missing required key, or a value that cannot be converted to the target type.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.DotEnvSerializer
files.Summary: Provides methods for serializing .NET objects to DotEnv text and deserializing DotEnv text into .NET objects, shaped after System.Text.Json's JsonSerializer.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.DotEnvSerializerDefaults
files.Summary: Specifies a set of default settings a can be initialized from.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.DotEnvSerializerOptions
files.Summary: Provides configuration for , controlling property naming, case sensitivity, field inclusion, null handling, and the export prefix on the write path.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.DotEnvTokenType
files.Summary: Enumerates the token kinds a reports as it advances through a DotEnv document.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.DotEnvValueKind
files.Summary: Enumerates the value kinds a DotEnv node or element can represent.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.Nodes.DotEnvNode
files.Summary: Represents a node in a mutable DotEnv document tree. A DotEnv document is a flat, ordered object of string-valued keys, so the tree has exactly two concrete shapes: a root and the string leaves it contains.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.Nodes.DotEnvObject
files.Summary: Represents the root of a mutable DotEnv document tree: an insertion-ordered map of key names to string leaves, with an optional per-entry export flag preserved for round-tripping.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.Nodes.DotEnvValue
files.Summary: Represents a string-valued leaf in a mutable DotEnv document tree.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.Reader.DotEnvReaderOptions
files.Summary: Provides configuration for a , controlling how the reader interprets optional DotEnv syntax conventions.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.Reader.Utf8DotEnvReader
files.Summary: Provides a high-performance, forward-only, allocation-light reader for DotEnv bytes. The reader is a ref struct, so it lives on the stack and cannot be boxed or captured; pass it by ref to thread it through a converter.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.Writer.DotEnvWriterOptions
files.Summary: Provides configuration for a , controlling how entries are emitted.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.DotEnv.Writer.Utf8DotEnvWriter
files.Summary: Provides a high-performance, forward-only writer that emits DotEnv text as UTF-8 bytes to an or a . The writer is a ref struct, so it lives on the stack and cannot be boxed or captured.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.Base16
files.Summary: Provides Base16 (hexadecimal) encoding and decoding of binary data, with support for flexible output formatting (case selection, byte spacing, line wrapping, 0x prefix) and lenient input parsing (prefix tolerance, whitespace stripping).

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.Base16Variant
files.Summary: Identifies the hexadecimal alphabet case used by .

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.Base32
files.Summary: Provides Base32 encoding and decoding of binary data across multiple variants (RFC 4648 standard and hex-extended, Crockford, z-base-32), with optional padding control and whitespace tolerance during parsing.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.Base32Variant
files.Summary: Identifies the Base32 alphabet and decoding rules used by .

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.Base45
files.Summary: Provides Base45 encoding and decoding of binary data as defined by RFC 9285 — the compact alphanumeric encoding used to carry binary payloads inside a QR code's Alphanumeric mode.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.Base58
files.Summary: Provides Base58 encoding and decoding of binary data using the Bitcoin/Flickr or Ripple alphabets.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.Base58Check
files.Summary: Provides Base58Check encoding and decoding — a Base58 superset used by Bitcoin addresses, WIF private keys, and related protocols. The encoder appends a four-byte checksum derived from the leading bytes of SHA-256(SHA-256(payload)) so that mistyped or truncated input can be detected at decode time.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.Base58Variant
files.Summary: Identifies the Base58 alphabet used by .

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.Base62
files.Summary: Provides Base62 encoding and decoding of binary data using the GMP-style alphabet 0-9 A-Z a-z.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.Base64
files.Summary: Provides Base64 encoding and decoding of binary data across the RFC 4648 standard, URL-safe, and MIME variants, with optional padding control and whitespace tolerance during parsing.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.Base64Url
files.Summary: Provides the RFC 4648 §5 URL- and filename-safe Base64 encoding as a first-class type, mirroring the shape of System.Buffers.Text.Base64Url introduced in .NET 9. URL-safe Base64 swaps + and / for - and _, and conventionally omits trailing = padding (matching JWT and OAuth practice).

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.Base64Variant
files.Summary: Identifies the Base64 alphabet and formatting rules used by .

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.Base85
files.Summary: Provides Base85 encoding and decoding of binary data using the Adobe Ascii85, ZeroMQ Z85, or Git-style alphabets.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.Base85Variant
files.Summary: Identifies the Base85 alphabet and framing rules used by .

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.BaseFormatStyles
files.Summary: Specifies formatting styles that influence how base-encoded input strings are parsed during decoding.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.BaseFormattingOptions
files.Summary: Defines formatting options that influence how encoded output is generated from binary data using any positional numeral system.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.Bech32
files.Summary: Provides Bech32 (BIP-173) and Bech32m (BIP-350) encoding and decoding — a checksummed base-32 format consisting of a human-readable part (HRP), the 1 separator, a data part of 5-bit groups, and a six-symbol error-detecting checksum.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.Bech32Encoding
files.Summary: Identifies the checksum constant used by — the original Bech32 scheme defined by BIP-173 or the Bech32m revision defined by BIP-350.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.BinaryEncodingExtensions
files.Summary: Provides fluent extension methods on arrays, of byte and , and that route through the canonical encoding implementations.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.BinaryEncodings
files.Summary: Provides ready-made instances for every variant supported by the library.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.IBinaryEncoding
files.Summary: Represents a binary-to-text encoding scheme (Base16, Base32, Base64, Base58, Base85, …) with the variant pre-bound, so that callers can pick or inject an encoding at runtime instead of dispatching through static classes.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.PercentDecodingOptions
files.Summary: Specifies relaxations applied by the decoder over its strict RFC 3986 default.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.PercentEncoding
files.Summary: Provides span-first percent-encoding and decoding of URI components and form-style values (RFC 3986 §2.1 with the WHATWG application/x-www-form-urlencoded rules), selecting the unescaped character set by component mode.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.PercentEncodingMode
files.Summary: Identifies the set of characters leaves unescaped, selecting the URI component or form-encoding rules to apply.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.QuotedPrintable
files.Summary: Provides MIME Quoted-Printable body encoding and decoding (RFC 2045 §6.7) of binary data, with selectable binary or canonical-text line handling, configurable soft line wrapping, and strict-by-default decoding.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.QuotedPrintableDecodingOptions
files.Summary: Specifies relaxations applied by the decoder over its strict RFC 2045 default.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.QuotedPrintableEncodingMode
files.Summary: Identifies how treats line breaks in the source when encoding.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Encoding.QuotedPrintableEncodingOptions

files.Summary: Forces a member to participate in serialization: a property's non-public accessors are bound (allowing members such as { get; private set; } or { get; init; } with a non-public setter to be read and written), and a public field is surfaced even when the serializer options' IncludeFields setting is disabled.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Serialization.KnownNamingPolicy

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Serialization.NamingPolicy

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Serialization.NamingPolicyAttribute

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Serialization.ObjectCreationHandling

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Serialization.ObjectCreationHandlingAttribute
files.Summary: Specifies, for the annotated type or member, whether the serializer replaces the value with a freshly created instance or populates the value already held during deserialization, overriding the serializer-wide preferred object-creation handling.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Serialization.PropertyNameAttribute
files.Summary: Specifies the key used for a property or field when it is serialized, overriding the member's CLR name and any configured naming policy.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Serialization.PropertyOrderAttribute
files.Summary: Specifies the relative order in which a property or field is written, allowing the order members are emitted to the writer to differ from the order in which they are declared.

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Serialization.RequiredAttribute

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Serialization.SerializationAttribute

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Serialization.StringEnumMemberNameAttribute

files.Title: Bodu.Text.Serialization.UnmappedMemberHandlingAttribute
files.Summary: Specifies, for the annotated type, how the serializer treats a dictionary key that maps to no member during deserialization, overriding the serializer-wide unmapped-member handling.
